errors.text: The proposed Hf/Mo additions do not reconstruct the target intervention of adding 4.2 at.% Cr to as-cast HfMoTaTiZr.
The claimed coherent nanoprecipitates and protective oxide layers are not established consequences of the proposed Hf/Mo additions by the cited evidence.
Adding dense Hf and Mo is not supported as a means of limiting density, and no density threshold or relevant same-alloy baseline is specified.
The conventional nickel-based-superalloy baseline is inconsistent with both the target and the proposed with-versus-without-addition experiment.
The hypothesis omits the quantitative strength and room-temperature ductility improvements required for a decisive comparison.
